messages:
Priya: opened PR to clarify certstore location and HSM notes for private/VPC installs. Links to Windows service install and RHEL packaging. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6231

Tom: nice. can we call out service account ownership on Windows (LocalService vs a dedicated svc account)? windows customers often hit perms.

Priya: yes, added a short Win svc note: recommend creating a dedicated "RedwoodSvc" with SeServiceLogonRight and granting the cert folder NTFS 750 equivalent (Read & Execute for service account).

Wei: for RHEL, include systemd tmpfiles.d snippet so cert dir is created at boot with correct ownership. also note `restorecon -R /opt/redwood/certs` for selinux.

Priya: added tmpfiles snippet and selinux restorecon note. Also added a sentence about stapled OCSP: if using stapled responses, ensure the stapling chain file is present and readable by the service user.

deploy-bot: docs build started for PR #6231 014 lint/link-check

deploy-bot: all checks passed ✅

Nina: can we include a tiny migration checklist for customers upgrading installer bundles? i.e., how to move certs and update kms.pkcs11.module_path to absolute path and verify.

Priya: added migration steps and a quick verification command for both Linux and Windows: Linux: `sudo -u redwood curl --cacert /opt/redwood/certs/root.pem https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz`. Windows (powershell as svc): `Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz -UseBasicParsing -Certificate (Get-PfxCertificate -FilePath C:\opt\redwood\certs\root.pfx)`

Tom: tiny nit: vendor PKCS#11 docs sometimes require a support token to download. add fallback text "contact your HSM vendor or SE if link blocked by vendor site".

Priya: done. Also added a short "if you see PKCS11 load errors" checklist (abs path, permissions, ldconfig vs direct path). merging after CI, will cherry-pick to maintenance branch and ping solutions-eng.
